CommitIgnoresBase.because: plan commit no longer compares base_version with the plan's current version, so two writers who proposed from the same version both commit and the second silently replaces what the first one's reader approved

CommitIgnoresTasksDigest.because: plan commit no longer compares the tasks digest, so a plan proposed for an older tasks snapshot is committed after a task changed

RetryCommitsAgain.because: a retry with the same idem_key commits a second time instead of returning the stored receipt, so one approval produces two versions

CloneSharesSource.because: plan clone writes into the plan it copies from, so a committed version of the source changes after it was approved

HoldKeyIncludesVersion.because: the hold's idempotency key includes the plan version, so an unchanged block gets a new key in the next version and the bot creates a second calendar event for it

CancelOnlyFromCurrentVersion.because: cancels are computed only from the current version's blocks, so a calendar event whose block a newer version dropped is never proposed for cancel and stays in the calendar
